title: AG60140: Crop Process Equipment Design
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Design of machine elements and their selection. Design of grains and other
crops processing machine components. Grain/crop processing systems design
involving, conveying, elevating, cleaning, separation, conditioning/parboiling,
milling and mixing. Design, laying and drawing of crop processing machines and
plants.
